units.source_text: 这媒人的妹妹，是在常陆守家西所——即浮舟房中——当差的。

en.t: This mediator's younger sister was serving in the western quarters of the Hitachi Governor's house, that is, in Ukifune's room.

units.source_text: 以前左近少将给浮舟的情书，都由此女传送。

en.t: In the past, the love letters that Sakon no Shosho sent to Ukifune had all been carried by this woman.

units.source_text: 但媒人自己其实不曾见过常陆守。

en.t: But the mediator himself had in fact never met the Hitachi Governor.

units.source_text: 这一天他贸然地来到常陆守的居处，央人通报：“有事要见主人。”

en.t: That day he went rashly to the Hitachi Governor's residence and asked someone to announce, "I have business and wish to see the master."

units.source_text: 常陆守冷淡地说：“我曾听说此人常在这里出入，

en.t: The Hitachi Governor said coldly, "I have heard that this man often comes and goes here,

units.source_text: 但我并未召他前来，今天他有什么事？”

en.t: but I did not summon him. What business does he have today?"

units.source_text: 媒人央人代答：“是左近少将大人派我来拜见的。”

en.t: The mediator asked someone to answer for him, "Lord Sakon no Shosho sent me to pay my respects."

units.source_text: 常陆守便和他会面。

en.t: So the Hitachi Governor met with him.

units.source_text: 媒人显出不好意思开口的样子，膝行到常陆守近旁，说道：

en.t: The mediator looked embarrassed to begin, moved forward on his knees to the Hitachi Governor's side, and said:

units.source_text: “月前少将有信给夫人，向小姐求婚，已蒙许诺，

en.t: "Some time ago, the Shosho sent a letter to your wife asking to marry the young lady, and his request was granted.

units.source_text: 约定于本月内结婚。

en.t: It was agreed that the marriage would take place within this month.

units.source_text: 少将已选定吉日，盼望早日成礼。

en.t: The Shosho has already chosen an auspicious day and hopes the ceremony can be completed soon.

units.source_text: 岂料有人对少将说：‘这位小姐虽然确是夫人所生，

en.t: Unexpectedly, someone said to the Shosho, 'Although this young lady was indeed born to your wife,

units.source_text: 但不是常陆守的亲生女儿。

en.t: she is not the Hitachi Governor's own daughter.

units.source_text: 你这贵公子攀这门亲，世人闻知了会说你讨好常陆守呢。

en.t: If a noble gentleman like you makes this match, people will hear of it and say you are currying favor with the Hitachi Governor.

units.source_text: 大凡贵公子当地方官的女婿，

en.t: In general, when a noble gentleman becomes the son-in-law of a provincial official,

units.source_text: 总是希望岳父像对家中主君一般尊重他，

en.t: he usually hopes his father-in-law will honor him as though he were the lord of the household,

units.source_text: 像掌上明珠一般爱护他，万事关怀照拂。

en.t: cherish him like a jewel in the palm, and attend to him with care in every matter.

units.source_text: 抱这目的而去当地方官女婿的人，原是有的。

en.t: There certainly are men who become sons-in-law of provincial officials with that aim in mind.

units.source_text: 如今你所娶的不是常陆守的亲生女儿，

en.t: But now, if the woman you marry is not the Hitachi Governor's own daughter,

units.source_text: 则上述的希望怕谈不到了。

en.t: then those hopes I just described can hardly be expected.

units.source_text: 岳父不把你当作女婿，对你的待遇比对别的女婿疏慢，

en.t: If your father-in-law does not treat you as his son-in-law and gives you poorer treatment than his other sons-in-law,

units.source_text: 在你实在是犯不着的。’

en.t: then it would truly not be worth it for you.'

units.source_text: 有很多人常常这样非难他，此刻少将困窘得很。

en.t: Many people have often criticized him in this way, and at present the Shosho is in great difficulty.

units.source_text: 他当初原是看中大人威望显赫，家道隆盛，

en.t: At first, he had his eye on Your Lordship's great prestige and flourishing household,

units.source_text: 可做他的靠山，这才提出求婚的，

en.t: thinking you could serve as his support, and only for that reason did he propose the marriage.

units.source_text: 却并不知道这位小姐是别人所生。

en.t: He did not know that this young lady was another man's child.

units.source_text: 因此他对我说：‘据说此外年纪尚幼的小姐甚多，

en.t: Therefore he said to me, 'I hear that there are many other young ladies here who are still quite young.

units.source_text: 倘蒙许诺一人，得偿夙愿，实甚欣幸。

en.t: If I could be granted even one of them, my long-cherished wish would be fulfilled, and I would be truly delighted.

units.source_text: 你就替我去探探口气吧。’”

en.t: Please go in my place and sound out their intentions.'"
